header: # BellLabs biotech knowledge graph: FINAL SCHEMA PROPOSAL (standalone, executable @neo4j/graphql SDL)
# Status: PROPOSAL produced by run run-2026-10-04-fable51-01 (docs/schema/ontology-lab/final-proposal-team/).
# Synthesizer: Fable 5.1 (claude-fable-5-1). Research/modeling workers: Opus 5.5, packages W00-W23.
# It does NOT replace docs/schema/current_biotech_schema.graphql (read-only) and does not change catalog 0.2.0 semantics
# except where the run's decision report records a reasoned, fixture-backed ruling. Semantic authority remains the
# catalog and architecture; this file is their executable GraphQL projection with full type definitions (no extend blocks).
# Verified build target: @neo4j/graphql 7.6.3, graphql 16.14.2, neo4j-driver 6.2.0, Node 22; Neo4j 5.26.31 Community
# (embedded) with APOC Core 5.26.31. APOC Core is REQUIRED: the library's generated Cypher calls apoc.date.convertFormat
# for every DateTime field read. Enterprise behaviour (property existence/type constraints) is unverified.
# final_biotech_schema_operations.enterprise.cypher companion. Validation and fixtures: the run's validation/ directory.
# Reading guide: every node type lists its stored labels (primary label first, archetype label last) in @node(labels:),
# carries uid (hu:<token>:<opaque>) beside the live id, and states for each relationship field its class
# (structural | asserted | derived) and cardinality in the field description. Asserted edges carry AssertedEdgeProperties
# (one Assertion per episode); derived edges carry DerivedEdgeProperties and are regenerable; nothing private-personal
# exists in this file. Uniqueness, indexes and application-enforced invariants live in the operations file and the
# validation suite: SDL nullability is not database enforcement.
# Domain banners below name the purpose and the competency questions each section serves (handoff section 7.3).

sections.title: KERNEL: archetypes, identity, time, assertion, Evidence Provenance (W00)
sections.purpose: Six archetype interfaces, shared enums and edge-property profiles, Source/Snapshot/Locator/Revision, Assertion, Adjudication, Activity/Agent, Identifier, Mention, EquivalenceAssessment. Status is capture fidelity, never truth; one asserter per assertion; bitemporal immutable history.

sections.title: ACTORS AND INSTITUTIONS (W01)
sections.purpose: Organizations, legal entities, brands, facilities, people and pseudonymous/anonymous actors; roles and the FINANCIAL_INTEREST family as time-bounded asserted edges. Brand is not legal entity; investment is not control; advising is not endorsement.

sections.title: SUBSTANCES AND MATERIALS (W02)
sections.purpose: Chemical substances and forms, ingredient materials, botanical and microbial preparations, mixtures, constituents and nutrients. Substance similarity never establishes material equivalence or active dose.

sections.title: BIOLOGY AND MECHANISMS (W03)
sections.purpose: Reference biology (mechanisms, pathways, molecular entities, species, anatomical contexts, conditions, outcomes, risk factors) and MechanismEvidenceContext. Inference is not measurement; compartment and species transfer is qualified.

sections.title: PRODUCTS, FORMULATIONS AND LABELS (W04)
sections.purpose: Enduring products, variants, package configurations, formulation versions and components, label snapshots and declarations. Current marketed product is not historical intervention; a declaration is not a measurement.

sections.title: FOOD, LIFESTYLE AND EXPOSURES (W05)
sections.purpose: Foods as ingredient materials, exposure characterizations and lifestyle practice concepts; intervention definition versus execution.

sections.title: TREATMENTS, PROCEDURES AND INTERVENTION MODALITIES (W06)
sections.purpose: Treatment concepts and procedure definitions; intent is not result, definition is not performance; no care records.

sections.title: DIAGNOSTICS AND MEASUREMENT (W07)
sections.purpose: Biomarkers, metrics, lab tests, panels, assay/algorithm/reference-interval versions, comparability and the DiagnosticResult contract. Same name or unit does not justify a shared trend axis.

sections.title: PLATFORMS, INSTRUMENTS AND DEVICES (W08)
sections.purpose: Technology platforms, instrument models, devices, sensors and modalities; device identity differs from assay configuration, performance claims and firmware.

sections.title: STUDIES, INTERVENTIONS AND RESULTS (W09)
sections.purpose: Study identity, registrations and their versions, arms, interventions and components, populations, outcome definitions, results, adverse events, publications and datasets. Registered is not completed; a shared dataset is not independent replication.

sections.title: EVIDENCE ASSESSMENT, APPLICABILITY AND SYNTHESIS (W10)
sections.purpose: EvidenceApplicability and its dimensions, use-context profiles, endpoint classification, result interpretation, synthesis and strength assessments. Evidence reaches commercial products only through applicability; confidence and truth differ.

sections.title: MANUFACTURING, SPECIFICATIONS AND SUPPLY READINESS (W11)
sections.purpose: Specifications and versions, processes and steps, capability states. Promotional language does not establish operating capacity.

sections.title: QUALITY TESTING AND CERTIFICATION (W12)
sections.purpose: Lots, samples, executions, methods, measured results, criteria, pass/fail interpretations, COAs and certification scope. Facility certification is not lot certification; a pass summary is not a measurement.

sections.title: REGULATION AND JURISDICTIONS (W13)
sections.purpose: Agencies, pathways and their versions, submissions, responses and statuses. Only APPROVAL is approval; marketed is not approved.

sections.title: INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND LICENSING (W14)
sections.purpose: Patent families, applications, grants, claims, licenses and trademarks. A license implies neither study ownership nor efficacy.

sections.title: COMMERCE AND ACCESS TO PRODUCTS (W15)
sections.purpose: Merchant listings, offers, price observations, subscriptions, bundles, inventory and affiliate links. Hosting, listing and fulfilment never imply seller of record.

sections.title: PROTOCOLS AND PUBLIC WORKFLOW DEFINITIONS (W16)
sections.purpose: Public protocols, immutable editions, steps with stable keys, dependencies, constraints, plans, adjustment rules, targets, public observations and results. Adoption never implies adherence; private execution stays outside the graph.

sections.title: SAFETY AND USE CONSTRAINTS (W17)
sections.purpose: Safety signals, adverse effects, contraindication and interaction assertions, shared use constraints. No events reported is not no events; unknown safety is not safe.

sections.title: COMMUNITIES, EVENTS AND NARRATIVE ARCS (W18)
sections.purpose: Communities, conferences, dated events and curated narrative arcs. Timeline or interpretation is never causal evidence.

sections.title: SOURCE INTELLIGENCE (W19)
sections.purpose: Candidate source authority, coverage and discovery records; source classification by claim type. No source-wide truth score.

sections.title: DOCUMENTS, TEXT VERSIONS AND CHUNKS (W20)
sections.purpose: Document as Source specialization, text versions bound to snapshots, segmentations and derived chunks. A chunk is never a locator.

sections.title: NARRATIVE MEDIA, SPEAKERS AND CLAIMS (W21)
sections.purpose: Platforms, channels, series, episodes and segments; Claim identity; ClaimOccurrence and RelationshipAssertion as assertions; retelling, qualification and conflict-relevance assessments. Human source content is not truth.

sections.title: MEDIA ASSETS, DEPICTIONS AND RIGHTS (W22)
sections.purpose: Media assets and renditions, annotations, figure panels, label regions, graph views, suitability assessments and rights records for entities AND concepts. Depiction is not proof; availability is not permission.

sections.title: ACCESS, ANSWERS, POLICY AND PRIVATE-STORE BOUNDARY (W23)
sections.purpose: AnswerRecord, PolicyVersion, DecisionCriterion and access tiers. The shared graph holds no private-personal element; private records are external contracts referencing shared uids.
sections.cqs: CQ-AX-01..28, CQ-PC, CQ-RC, CQ-PV-06; QS-5, QS-6
